heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 1849年12月6日生於萊普尼茨（維滕貝格縣）。1869年10月以一年期志願兵身分加入驃騎兵團，並參加1870至71年的戰事。1894年出任駐但澤的第1近衛驃騎兵團團長，1900年晉升少將，1903年起任第36師師長。
body.en: Born on 6 December 1849 at Leipnitz, district of Wittenberg. In October 1869 he entered a hussar regiment as a one-year volunteer and took part in the 1870/71 campaign. He commanded the 1st Leib-Hussar Regiment at Danzig from 1894, became major general in 1900 and from 1903 commanded the 36th Division.

heading.en: Corps commander and the first months in the East

body.zh-Hant: 1908年起，他以騎兵上將身分擔任第17軍軍長。一戰爆發後，所部隸屬第8軍團，參加了貢賓嫩、坦能堡與馬祖里湖區的戰役。1914年11月1日他受任第9軍團總司令，擋住俄軍主力北翼對波森與西里西亞兩省的攻勢；12月17日晉升大將。
body.en: From 1908 he was commanding general of the XVII Army Corps as General of Cavalry. After the outbreak of the war his corps, within the 8th Army, fought at Gumbinnen, Tannenberg and the Masurian Lakes. Named commander of the 9th Army on 1 November 1914, he halted the attack of the northern flank of the main Russian forces on the provinces of Posen and Silesia, and was promoted Generaloberst on 17 December.

heading.en: Eleventh Army: the Gorlice–Tarnow breakthrough

body.zh-Hant: 1915年4月16日，他受命統率新組建的第11軍團，任務是解放加利西亞。5月2日他在塔爾努夫—戈爾利採突破俄軍戰線，隨後解放倫貝格（6月22日），8月26日攻佔布列斯特—立陶夫斯克要塞。他並在6月22日晉升元帥。
body.en: On 16 April 1915 he was appointed commander of the newly formed 11th Army, which was to liberate Galicia. His operational breakthrough of the Russian front at Tarnow-Gorlice on 2 May was followed by the liberation of Lemberg and the capture of the fortress of Brest-Litovsk (26 August); he was made Generalfeldmarschall on 22 June 1915.

heading.zh-Hant: 集團軍群：塞爾維亞與羅馬尼亞
heading.en: Army group: Serbia and Romania

body.zh-Hant: 1915年5月16日起，他受命統率一個集團軍群，與奧地利、保加利亞和土耳其部隊配合，擊破塞爾維亞的抵抗；10月9日貝爾格勒陷落。1916年9月初他率聯軍進入多布羅加，到1917年1月中旬征服羅馬尼亞，並成為一戰中第二位獲授鐵十字大十字勳章的將領。他的集團軍群分成三個軍團，留在羅馬尼亞直到戰爭結束。
body.en: From 16 May 1915 he held the supreme command of an army group tasked with breaking Serbian resistance together with Austrian, Bulgarian and Turkish forces; Belgrade fell on 9 October. In early September 1916 he entered the Dobruja with allied troops and conquered Romania by mid-January 1917, for which he became the second general of the war to receive the Grand Cross of the Iron Cross. His army group, divided into three armies, stayed in Romania until the war ended.

heading.zh-Hant: 羅馬尼亞停戰與佔領軍司令部
heading.en: Romanian armistice and the occupation command

body.zh-Hant: 1917年12月，馬肯森使羅馬尼亞簽下停戰。1918年6月15日起，聯邦檔案館人物表列他為駐羅馬尼亞總司令；7月1日，原集團軍群司令部改稱「佔領軍最高司令部」，簡稱「馬肯森最高司令部」。
body.en: In December 1917 Mackensen brought Romania to an armistice. From 15 June 1918 the Federal Archives' table lists him as commander-in-chief in Romania, and on 1 July 1918 the army-group command was renamed the Oberkommando des Besatzungsheeres, in short 'Oberkommando Mackensen'.

heading.en: After the war and last years

body.zh-Hant: 戰後他先被拘於匈牙利，後被拘於薩洛尼卡，1919年11月才得以返國。希特勒為利用他的聲望，1933年將他召入普魯士國務院，1936年任命他為斯托爾普騎兵第5團的名譽團長。他被視為舊軍隊最後一位元帥，1945年11月8日卒於策勒縣的布爾格霍恩。
body.en: He was interned first in Hungary and then at Salonika, and could return home only in November 1919. Hitler sought to exploit his popularity: in 1933 he appointed him to the Prussian State Council and in 1936 made him Chef of Cavalry Regiment 5 at Stolp. Regarded as the last field marshal of the old army, he died on 8 November 1945 at Burghorn near Celle.

heading.en: Origins and Prussian career

body.zh-Hant: 1855年2月18日生於波美拉尼亞的施托爾普。1874年加入黑森大公國第115步兵團，1878至81年就讀軍事學院，其後多年任職於總參謀部。1900年起負責指揮第6驃騎兵團，接著指揮第15騎兵旅；1911年晉升中將，任卡塞爾第22師師長。
body.en: Born on 18 February 1855 at Stolp in Pomerania. He entered the 115th Hessian Infantry Regiment in 1874, attended the Kriegsakademie in 1878–81 and for many years served on the General Staff. From 1900 he led the 6th Hussar Regiment and then the 15th Cavalry Brigade; in 1911 he became lieutenant general and commander of the 22nd Division at Kassel.

citations.quote: * 18.2.1855 Stolp (Pommern)
trat L. 1874 in das 1. Ghzgl. Hess. Infanterie-Rgt. Nr. 115 ein
absolvierte 1878-81 die Kriegsakademie
wirkte viele Jahre hindurch im Generalstab
1900 wurde ihm die Führung des Husaren-Rgt. Nr. 6 in Leobschütz anvertraut
dann die der 15. Kavallerie-Brigade
1911 wurde er zum Generalleutnant und Kommandeur der 22. Division

heading.en: The military mission to Turkey

body.zh-Hant: 1913年2月8日，他被派往君士坦丁堡出任德國軍事使團團長，負責整頓巴爾幹戰爭後陷於混亂的土耳其陸軍，同時接掌當地第1軍；此舉引起俄、英、法三國抗議。1914年1月14日他晉升普魯士騎兵上將並獲奧斯曼元帥銜，擔任土耳其陸軍總監察長。
body.en: On 8 February 1913 he was sent to Constantinople as chief of the German military mission to reorganise the Turkish army, which had been left in a desolate state by the Balkan wars; he also took over the I Army Corps there, which provoked protests from Russia, Britain and France. On 14 January 1914 he was promoted Prussian General of Cavalry and Ottoman marshal and became Inspector-General of the Turkish army.

heading.zh-Hant: 卸下軍長職務與出任總監察長
heading.en: Giving up the corps command, becoming inspector-general

body.zh-Hant: 1914年1月11日，李曼辭去君士坦丁堡第1軍軍長一職。1月14日，他晉升土耳其元帥並出任總監察長，仍保有軍事使團團長身分；德國外交部名錄記他為1913至1918年的使團團長。
body.en: On 11 January 1914 Liman von Sanders resigned as commander of the First Army Corps. On 14 January he was made a Turkish marshal and Inspector General while remaining head of the Military Mission; a German Foreign Office name list gives him as head of the mission for 1913–1918.

heading.en: The Gallipoli campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1914年10月土耳其加入同盟國作戰後，他出任第1軍團總司令，1915年3月24日改任第5軍團總司令，該軍團部署在加里波利半島。4月底協約國部隊登陸，兵力與裝備遠勝第5軍團；他指揮達達尼爾防禦戰，12月底協約國撤出加里波利。穆斯塔法·凱末爾（阿塔圖克）是他麾下幹練的軍官之一。
body.en: After Turkey entered the war on the side of the Central Powers in October 1914 he became commander of the 1st Army and, on 24 March 1915, of the 5th Army, deployed on the Gallipoli peninsula. The Entente troops who landed at the end of April 1915 were far superior to the 5th Army in numbers and equipment; he directed the defence of the Dardanelles, and at the end of December the Entente evacuated Gallipoli. Mustafa Kemal (Atatürk) was among his ablest officers.

heading.zh-Hant: F集團軍群：巴勒斯坦戰線
heading.en: Army Group F: the Palestine front

body.zh-Hant: 1918年2月27日，他接替法爾肯海因，出任F集團軍群總司令，以挽救瀕臨崩潰的巴勒斯坦戰線。春季他擊退英軍在約旦河的兩次進攻；9月20日英軍突襲其在拿撒勒的司令部，他僅僅險些被俘。土耳其10月31日與協約國停戰後，他把巴勒斯坦軍的殘部交給繼任者凱末爾。
body.en: On 27 February 1918 he was appointed commander-in-chief of Army Group F as Falkenhayn's successor, when the Palestine front threatened to collapse. In spring he repelled the British in the two Jordan battles; when the British raided his headquarters at Nazareth on 20 September he barely escaped capture. When Turkey concluded the armistice on 31 October 1918 he handed the remnants of the Palestine army to his successor Kemal.

heading.en: Internment and last years

body.zh-Hant: 1919年2月他被英軍拘禁於馬爾他，同年8月獲釋。他晚年居住慕尼黑，1929年8月22日去世；在土耳其，他長期以「利曼帕夏」和「加里波利之獅」之名廣為人知。
body.en: He was interned by the British on Malta in February 1919 and released in August. He spent his last years in Munich and died on 22 August 1929; in Turkey he long remained popular as 'Liman Pasha' and the 'Lion of Gallipoli'.

heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 1856年6月4日生於摩拉維亞的大澤洛維茨。1871年在蒂羅爾皇家獵兵團展開軍旅生涯；1882年11月起任少將並在普雷斯堡任旅長，1886年任中將、師長，1889年9月出任普雷斯堡第5軍軍長。
body.en: Born on 4 June 1856 at Groß-Seelowitz in Moravia. He began his military career in 1871 with the Tyrolean Kaiserjäger Regiment; from November 1882 he was major general and brigadier at Pressburg, in 1886 divisional commander as Feldmarschalleutnant, and in September 1889 commander of the V Corps there.

citations.quote: * 4.6.1856 Groß-Seelowitz (Mähren)
begann F. 1871 die militärische Laufbahn im Tiroler Kaiserjägerregiment
Seit November 1882 Generalmajor und Brigadier in Preßburg
1886 Feldmarschalleutnant und Divisionär im gleichen Garnisonsort
im September 1889 zum Kommandanten des V. Korps

heading.zh-Hant: 總兵監、領土防衛軍與軍團監察官
heading.en: Troop inspector, Landwehr command and army inspector

body.zh-Hant: 1905年4月起，他任總兵監；1907年受命統率奧地利皇家領土防衛軍（Landwehr）的最高指揮部，1910年被任命為軍團監察官。奧地利領土防衛軍在他任內被培養成「第一線」部隊，並獲得訓練精良的山地部隊的裝備。
body.en: From April 1905 he was general troop inspector; in 1907 he obtained the high command of the Imperial-Royal Austrian Landwehr, and in 1910 he was appointed army inspector. Under him the Landwehr was developed into a 'first line' force and received well-trained mountain troops.

citations.quote: Seit April 1905 Generaltruppeninspektor
1907 die Betrauung mit dem Oberkommando
Oberkommando der kaiserlich königlichen österreichischen Landwehr
1910 die Ernennung zum Armeeinspektor
Daß die Landwehr zu einem Heereskörper der „ersten Linie“
hervorragend ausgebildete Gebirgstruppen

heading.zh-Hant: 軍隊最高指揮權與初期戰局
heading.en: Supreme command of the army in the first campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 大戰爆發時，皇帝弗朗茨·約瑟夫一世把「軍隊最高指揮部」（Armeeoberkommando）交給他並授予元帥銜，而軍隊的戰略指揮則交給康拉德·馮·赫岑多夫。《奧地利人物傳記辭典》則寫他1914年接掌奧匈武裝力量的最高指揮權。在1914至15年對俄開局戰役（Einleitungsfeldzug）的嚴重危機中，他以調和的態度與康拉德共同領導最高指揮部。
body.en: At the outbreak of the war Emperor Franz Joseph I entrusted him with the Armeeoberkommando and made him field marshal, while the strategic direction of the armies went to Conrad von Hötzendorf. The Austrian Biographical Lexicon says he took over the supreme command of the k.u.k. armed forces in 1914. In the severe crises of the opening campaign against Russia in 1914/15 he led the high command jointly with Conrad in a conciliatory spirit.

citations.quote: Bei Ausbruch des Weltkrieges übertrug Kaiser Franz Joseph I.
F. das Armeeoberkommando und ernannte ihn zum Feldmarschall
Die strategische Führung der Armeen wurde Conrad von Hötzendorf übergeben
Übernahm 1914 den Oberbefehl über die k. u. k. Wehrmacht
in den schweren Krisen des Einleitungsfeldzuges 1914/15 gegen Rußland
durch seine ausgleichende, keine Verantwortung scheuende Haltung
das Armeeoberkommando mit Conrad erfolgreich gemeinsam geführt

heading.zh-Hant: 卡爾一世即位後的離職
heading.en: Departure after Karl I's accession

body.zh-Hant: 1916年卡爾一世即位時，他起初被任命為卡爾在最高指揮部的代理人，並於1917年辭職（辭典則寫1916年12月被置於待命）。1918年夏季攻勢前，他再度出聲反對明顯失當的計畫。
body.en: When Karl I came to the throne in 1916 he was first appointed his deputy in the Armeeoberkommando and resigned in 1917 (the Austrian lexicon says he was placed at disposal in December 1916). Before the summer offensive of 1918 he once more raised his voice against the manifestly faulty planning.

citations.quote: Karls I. 1916 zunächst zu dessen Stellvertreter im Armeeoberkommando ernannt
trat er 1917 zurück
im Dezember 1916 zur Disposition gestellt
Anläßlich der Offensive im Sommer 1918 erhob er noch einmal seine Stimme
gegen die offenkundlichen Fehlplanungen

heading.en: After the war and death

body.zh-Hant: 1918年之後，他失去了在各繼承國的許多產業，在短暫流亡瑞士後隱居匈牙利；1936年12月30日卒於匈牙利舊堡。他獲有瑪麗亞·特蕾西亞勳章與聖斯德望勳章大十字。
body.en: After 1918 he lost many of his estates in the successor states and, after a brief exile in Switzerland, lived in seclusion in Hungary; he died on 30 December 1936 at Ungarisch Altenburg. He held the Grand Cross of the Orders of Maria Theresa and of St Stephen.

body.zh-Hant: 1880年5月14日生於烏爾姆附近的上基爾希貝格。1898年7月他以志願兵身分加入慕尼黑獨立工兵支隊，1904年任第1營副官；1908年10月起奉派入慕尼黑軍事學院，走上總參謀軍官的道路。
body.en: Born on 14 May 1880 at Oberkirchberg near Ulm. In July 1898 he entered the independent pioneer detachment at Munich as a volunteer, became adjutant of the 1st Battalion in 1904, and from October 1908 was sent to the Kriegsakademie in Munich, beginning his General Staff career.

heading.zh-Hant: 一戰參謀職務與自由軍團
heading.en: General Staff posts in the First World War and the Freikorps

body.zh-Hant: 1914年3月19日他調入慕尼黑的總參謀部中央處。大戰期間，他於1914／15年任巴伐利亞第2軍的第4總參軍官，1917／18年任巴伐利亞第8預備師的第1總參軍官，戰爭結束時在慕尼黑陸軍部。艾斯納遇刺後，他加入埃普自由軍團，參與鎮壓蘇維埃共和國（1919年晉升少校）。
body.en: On 19 March 1914 he was transferred to the central office of the General Staff in Munich. During the war he was 4th General Staff officer of the II Bavarian Army Corps (1914/15), and in 1917/18 first General Staff officer of the 8th Bavarian Reserve Division; he spent the end of the war in the Munich war ministry. After Eisner's murder he joined Freikorps Epp and took part in suppressing the Soviet republic (major in 1919).

citations.quote: wurde L. am 19.3.1914 in die Zentralstelle des Generalstabs in München versetzt
4. Generalstabsoffizier des II. Bayer. Armeekorps (1914/15)
1917/18 1. Generalstabsoffizier der 8. Bayer. Reservedivision
Das Kriegsende erlebte L. im Münchener Kriegsministerium
stieß aber nach Eisners Ermordung zum Freikorps Epp

body.zh-Hant: 1923年11月，他以肯普滕營長的身分參與鎮壓希特勒政變。1924至33年他專注於訓練工作：1927年3月1日以上校身分接替布隆貝格，任柏林國防部陸軍訓練處（T4）處長；1930年2月1日起任德勒斯登步兵學校校長，該校是陸軍唯一的軍官學校。
body.en: In November 1923, as a battalion commander at Kempten, he helped suppress the Hitler putsch. From 1924 to 1933 he devoted himself to training: from 1 March 1927 he was, as colonel and Blomberg's successor, head of the Army Training Department (T 4) in the Reichswehr ministry in Berlin, and from 1 February 1930 commandant of the Infantry School at Dresden, the army's only officer school.

body.zh-Hant: 1933年10月他任德勒斯登第4師師長；1935年6月該師擴編為第4軍。1938年2月他任卡塞爾第2集團軍群總司令，兩個月後改任新編的維也納第4集團軍群總司令。1939年波蘭戰役中他指揮第14軍團（克拉科夫—倫貝格方向），1940年西線戰役指揮第12軍團，並於1940年7月19日晉升元帥。
body.en: In October 1933 he became commander of the 4th Division at Dresden, which grew into the IV Army Corps in June 1935. In February 1938 he took command of Army Group 2 at Kassel and two months later of the new Army Group 4 in Vienna. In the Polish campaign of 1939 he led the 14th Army (advance Cracow–Lemberg) and in the Western campaign of 1940 the 12th Army; he was promoted Generalfeldmarschall on 19 July 1940.

heading.zh-Hant: 巴爾幹戰役、A集團軍群與戰後審判
heading.en: The Balkan campaign, Army Group A and the postwar trial

body.zh-Hant: 1941年4月6日，他的第12軍團從保加利亞出發，進攻南斯拉夫南部與薩洛尼卡，迫使希臘軍隊4月21日在拉里薩投降；其後他兼任東南國防軍司令。1942年7月他受命統率新編的A集團軍群，兩個月後因高加索作戰方針與希特勒衝突，9月10日被免職。1947至48年他在紐倫堡受審，1948年2月19日被判無期徒刑，1952年聖誕節獲釋。
body.en: On 6 April 1941 his 12th Army advanced from Bulgaria against southern Yugoslavia and Salonika and forced the Greek army to capitulate at Larissa on 21 April; he was then also made Wehrmachtbefehlshaber Südost. In July 1942 he received the supreme command of the new Army Group A; two months later disagreements with Hitler over the continuation of the Caucasus operations led to his removal on 10 September. He stood trial at Nuremberg in 1947/48, was sentenced to life imprisonment on 19 February 1948 and released at Christmas 1952.

body.zh-Hant: 1887年1月1日生於威斯特法倫的阿普勒貝克。1905年他進入海軍。1914年他參加福克蘭群島海戰；1915年3月「德勒斯登」號自沉後，他在智利被拘留。
body.en: Born on 1 January 1887 at Aplerbeck in Westphalia. He joined the navy in 1905. In 1914 he took part in the Battle of the Falkland Islands and, after the scuttling of the 'Dresden' in March 1915, was interned in Chile.

heading.zh-Hant: 西班牙任務、潛艇與革命動亂
heading.en: Spain, the U-boat and the revolutionary turmoil

body.zh-Hant: 他經歷逃亡與返國後，1915至16年以大尉身分為海軍參謀部在西班牙執行秘密任務。其後依本人意願改調前線，大戰結束時在地中海指揮一艘潛艇。1918至19年革命動亂期間，他任近衛騎兵射擊師的聯絡軍官。
body.en: After a venturesome escape and return home, Kapitänleutnant Canaris carried out a secret mission for the Admiralty Staff in Spain in 1915/16. At his own wish he was then employed at the front and at the end of the war commanded a U-boat in the Mediterranean. During the revolutionary turmoil of 1918/19 he was liaison officer to the Garde-Kavallerie-Schützendivision.

heading.en: Naval posts in the Weimar years

body.zh-Hant: 1920年7月之後，他任波羅的海海軍基地的海軍參謀軍官；1924至28年在海軍領導部任職。1928年他任「西里西亞」號戰艦大副，1930年任北海海軍基地參謀長，1932年以海軍上校身分出任「西里西亞」號艦長；1934年秋他被派為斯維內明德要塞司令，這被視為一種「退役前的職位」。
body.en: After July 1920 he was an Admiralty Staff officer of the Baltic Station; in 1924–28 he served in the Navy Command. In 1928 he became first officer of the battleship 'Schlesien', in 1930 chief of staff of the North Sea Station, and in 1932, as Captain, commander of the 'Schlesien'; in autumn 1934 he received the 'retirement post' of fortress commander at Swinemünde.

heading.en: Chief of the Abwehr

body.zh-Hant: 1935年1月1日，在前任帕齊希與納粹黨公開衝突後，他以海軍少將身分被任命為國防部防諜局長（1938年3月起為國防軍最高統帥部外國／防諜局）。受1938年弗里奇事件影響，他讓防諜局成為反希特勒的技術中心；1940年1月1日晉升海軍上將。1944年2月，一名在土耳其的特工逃向英國人後，他被免職。
body.en: On 1 January 1935, after his predecessor Patzig had come into open conflict with the NSDAP, he was appointed, as Konteradmiral, chief of the Abwehr department (from March 1938 the Foreign/Abwehr Office of the OKW). Under the impression of the Fritsch affair of 1938 he let the Abwehr become a technical centre of the opposition to Hitler; he became Admiral on 1 January 1940. In February 1944, after one of his agents in Turkey fled to the British, he was dismissed.

als Konteradmiral zum Chef der Abwehrabteilung
(ab März 1938: Amt Ausland/Abwehr des OKW)

ein technisches Zentrum der Opposition gegen Hitler entstehen

als einer seiner Agenten in der Türkei zu den Engländern flüchtete
im Februar 1944 seiner Stellung enthoben

heading.en: Arrest and execution

body.zh-Hant: 7月20日事件三天後他被逮捕，其後齊曾（措森）發現的檔案使他的命運已定。經過一次可疑的黨衛軍即決審判，他在1945年4月9日於弗洛森比格集中營被絞死。
body.en: Arrested three days after 20 July, he was doomed by the discovery of the Zossen files. After a dubious SS summary trial he was hanged on 9 April 1945 in Flossenbürg concentration camp.

citations.quote: Drei Tage nach dem 20. Juli verhaftet
besiegelte der Zossener Aktenfund
Nach einem fragwürdigen SS-Standrechtsverfahren
wurde er noch am 9.4.1945 im Konzentrationslager Flossenbürg gehängt
